guesses.breed: American Staffordshire Terrier / Pit Bull Terrier
guesses.reason: Broad blocky head, muscular stocky build, short smooth fawn-and-white coat, and wide muzzle with a strong jaw are classic bully-breed traits.
Compact, sturdy frame, pronounced cheek muscles, and a white blaze and chest on a fawn coat fit the Staffie type.
Fawn coat with white blaze and the slightly squared muzzle with dark mask shading around the mouth hint at some Boxer influence.

breed.appearance: Medium-sized, stocky, muscular dog with a short, smooth fawn (light tan) coat, a broad white blaze running from forehead down the muzzle, and a white chest, front, and paws. Her large, upright, naturally erect ears are thin with pink insides and slightly folded tips, framing a broad head with amber-brown eyes, a black nose, and a dark gray muzzle mottled with pink patches on the upper lip. She wears a pink collar with a silver tag and is attached to a bright orange leash.
breed.fun_fact: Pit bull–type dogs are famously affectionate goofballs who love nothing more than snuggling up with their favorite people!
